title: Northbridge Clinical Package Line-Up: Sponsor Election and Enrolled-Lives Minimums
content:
The Utilization Management Program is offered to plan sponsors in six review packages. A package applies to a sponsor's members only when the sponsor has elected that package, and each package carries a minimum number of enrolled lives the sponsor must have.

| Rank | Review package | Sponsor must elect the package | Minimum enrolled lives |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Northbridge Clinical Essentials | Yes | 2 |
| 2 | Northbridge Clinical Standard | Yes | 2 |
| 3 | Northbridge Clinical Advanced | Yes | 51 |
| 4 | Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | Yes | 101 |
| 5 | Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | Yes | 251 |
| 6 | Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | Yes | 501 |

### Reading the schedule

- The minimum is a floor: a sponsor with exactly 51 enrolled lives meets the Northbridge Clinical Advanced minimum, and a sponsor with 50 does not.
- Every package requires the sponsor's own election; enrolled-lives size alone does not place a sponsor in a package.
- The rank is the package's position in the line-up, from 1 to 6.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a sponsor with 120 enrolled lives that has elected Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus meets that package's minimum of 101; the same sponsor would not meet the 251-life minimum of Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive.
